title: Garanti BBVA Completes the Sale of Its Romanian Subsidiary
summary: Garanti BBVA has successfully completed the sale of its Romanian subsidiary to Raiffeisen Bank – the Romanian unit of the Austrian bank, Raiffeisen Bank International AG (RBI) – for €571 million, after receiving the necessary regulatory approvals.
body_markdown:
Garanti BBVA has successfully completed the[sale of its Romanian subsidiary to Raiffeisen Bank](https://www.bbva.com/en/economy-and-finance/garanti-bbva-reaches-agreement-to-sell-its-romanian-unit/) – the Romanian unit of the Austrian bank, Raiffeisen Bank International AG (RBI) – for €571 million, after receiving the necessary regulatory approvals.


[Communications](https://www.bbva.com/en/guest-authors/communications/)


[Listen to audio](https://app-eu.readspeaker.com/cgi-bin/rsent?customerid=8166&lang=en&readclass=detContHeader1185119,detContContent1185119&url=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.bbva.com%2Fen%2Feconomy-and-finance%2Fgaranti-bbva-completes-the-sale-of-its-romanian-subsidiary%2F)[Leer en español](https://www.bbva.com/es/economia-y-finanzas/garanti-bbva-concluye-la-venta-de-su-filial-en-rumania/)


The transaction amount totals €571 million. It will generate net capital gains of approximately €83 after tax. In addition, it will have a positive impact on the BBVA Group’s CET1 ratio of around 8 basis points.


Garanti BBVA’s subsidiary in Romania is the country’s tenth-largest financial institution in terms of asset volume, with a market share of approximately two percent, and assets totaling €4 billion at the end of 2025 (less than five percent of Garanti BBVA’s assets).
